minecraft_ash.description: a few tiny dark-gray to black square specks hang in the sky at t3 in front and threequarter views; a couple of residual specks remain at t8; nothing visible at t20. top view t8 shows small dark and gray specks scattered among the background dirt-debris chunks; top t3 shows only the debris pile; top t20 is clean grass.
minecraft_ash.notes: specks are only a few pixels each and sit in the sky region, so they are airborne particles, not the ground debris pile.

minecraft_composter.description: every front and threequarter cell shows only flat grass and sky; top views show only the brown dirt-debris chunks (one pile at t3, scattered chunks at t8, one chunk at t20). no colored or non-debris pixels observed anywhere.
minecraft_composter.notes: effect may be too small or timed outside the captures; nothing separable from background debris.

minecraft_dripping_lava.description: three to four bright orange square droplets float in the air above the horizon at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views; by t20 they have landed and appear as one to three small red-orange flat splat marks resting on the grass in all three angles including the top view.

persistence: drips land by t20 and remain as splats

minecraft_dripping_lava.notes: droplets are small but distinct; ground splats are clearly separate from the debris pile by color and shape.

minecraft_electric_spark.description: front and threequarter cells are all empty sky and grass; top views contain only the brown dirt-debris chunks. no spark or colored pixels visible.
minecraft_electric_spark.notes: nothing distinguishable from the baseline in any of the nine cells.

minecraft_falling_honey.description: small amber-yellow square droplets cluster in the air at t3 in front and threequarter views; at t8 and t20 they appear as flat elongated yellow streaks lying on the grass; top t3 shows a large cluster of overlapping flat amber-orange square splats on the ground beside the debris pile; top t8 and t20 show small yellow specks and streaks scattered among the debris chunks.

shape: flat elongated streaks and splats on ground
scale_impression: large flat ground splats from top view

minecraft_falling_honey.notes: the large amber patches in top t3 are flat square quads clustered at the anchor, consistent with landed drops rather than placed blocks.

minecraft_glow.description: one or two tiny teal-green star-shaped sparkle specks appear in the sky at t3 in front and threequarter views; everything else, including all top views and t8 onward, is empty except background debris.
minecraft_glow.notes: only a couple of sparkle pixels at t3; easy to miss at sheet scale but distinct in color.

minecraft_item_cobweb.description: a few small white angular blocky specks sit near the ground at t3 in front, threequarter and top views; they look like tiny white item-shaped sprites; one small white speck remains at t8; nothing at t20. top t3 shows the white angular marks next to the debris pile.
minecraft_item_cobweb.notes: white marks are angular and clearly separate from the brown debris; low count keeps this faint.

minecraft_note.description: all cells are empty except the background dirt-debris chunks in top views; the only anomaly is a slightly darker grass patch in threequarter t20 that matches grass texture variation at zoom.
minecraft_note.notes: the dark patch in threequarter t20 resolves to plain grass at 3x zoom; no note-like sprites seen.

minecraft_sculk_soul.description: small dark near-black wisp clusters speckled with cyan dots float in the sky at t3 and shrink to a single dark speck with a cyan point by t8 in front and threequarter views; gone by t20; top views show only debris.

density: small clusters of two to four specks

minecraft_sculk_soul.notes: cyan dots inside the dark cluster are distinctive and consistent across both angled rows.

minecraft_spit.description: t3 shows a burst of white angular blobs on the grass in front and threequarter views and a large irregular splatter of overlapping light gray to white flat rectangles across the top view; by t8 only a few small white specks remain on the grass; empty by t20.

scale_impression: large splat footprint in top view

minecraft_spit.notes: the top-view splatter footprint is the clearest frame; front views show the same white blobs at ground level.

minecraft_vault_connection.description: all front and threequarter cells are empty grass and sky; top views show only the brown dirt-debris chunks. faint specks suspected at thumbnail scale resolve to plain grass at 3x zoom.
minecraft_vault_connection.notes: verified empty at full resolution in the suspect cells; the connection effect may be invisible from these angles or timings.

world_event_ANIMATION_SPAWN_COBWEB.description: a brief cluster of small cream-white angular specks appears low near the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views; front t8 shows one large pale off-white angular blob high in the sky which may be a drifting cloud; all other cells are empty apart from the debris pile in top views.

scale_impression: small specks plus one large blob

world_event_ANIMATION_SPAWN_COBWEB.notes: the large pale blob at front t8 could be a background cloud rather than the effect; the t3 ground cluster is the likelier effect signature.

world_event_PARTICLES_DRAGON_BLOCK_BREAK.description: front and threequarter rows are completely empty; top views contain only the brown dirt-debris chunks; the candidate faint specks in top t20 resolve to clean grass at 3x zoom.
world_event_PARTICLES_DRAGON_BLOCK_BREAK.notes: no purple or colored particles visible; possibly mistimed or emitted below frame.

world_event_PARTICLES_SHOOT_SMOKE.description: a single tiny dark speck cluster sits at the very top edge of the front t3 frame, consistent with a puff exiting above the captured region; every other cell is empty except the debris pile in top views.

motion: likely moving up out of frame

world_event_PARTICLES_SHOOT_SMOKE.notes: only evidence is a few dark pixels clipped at the frame's top edge in one cell.

world_event_PARTICLES_TURTLE_EGG_PLACEME.description: all front and threequarter cells are empty; top t8 shows a wider scatter of the same brown dirt-textured debris chunks, but nothing non-debris; top t3 and t20 show the pile or clean grass.
world_event_PARTICLES_TURTLE_EGG_PLACEME.notes: top t8 has more debris chunks in frame than other cells, all matching the declared background dirt texture.

superheroes_dazzling.description: loose clusters of small pink-magenta four-point star sparkles drift across the sky in front and threequarter views at all three ticks, migrating left to right and thinning to one or two specks by t20; top views show only debris plus one tiny dark speck at t20.

density: loose cluster of four to eight specks

superheroes_dazzling.notes: star shapes and consistent drift make these clearly identifiable effect particles.

superheroes_homelander_iron_fists_impact.description: a large soft translucent pinkish-white haze fills part of the sky at front t3; a smaller fainter puff remains at front t8; threequarter row is empty at all ticks; top views show only the debris pile.
superheroes_homelander_iron_fists_impact.notes: visible only in the front row; so translucent it nearly merges with the sky.

superheroes_laser_spark.description: clusters of small orange-gold star sparkles hang in the sky in front and threequarter views at t3 and t8, thinning to a couple of specks by t20; top t20 shows a cluster of large flat orange-tan rectangular patches at the frame edge, block-scale, which may be a scene structure drifting into view rather than particles.

shape: large flat rectangles in top view

superheroes_laser_spark.notes: the big orange rectangles in top t20 are much larger than the sparkles and sit at the frame edge; likely a lava or gold structure, flagged as ambiguous.

superheroes_scorpion_hellfire.description: all cells are empty grass and sky; top views contain only the brown dirt-debris chunks, some with bluish flecks that match the pile texture. no fire or hellfire pixels visible.
superheroes_scorpion_hellfire.notes: nothing observed at any tick or angle; effect may be positioned off-frame or failed to emit.

superheroes_white_boom.description: a loose cluster of roughly eight to ten tiny pale yellow-white specks floats in the sky at t3 in front and threequarter views; it thins to one or two tiny specks by t8 and t20; top views show only debris.
superheroes_white_boom.notes: specks are only a few pixels each; consistent positions across rows confirm they are real and not noise.
